name: Personal leave, unpaid (事假)
authority: Interim Wage Payment Regulation (劳部发〔1994〕489号) arts.11–12 list the paid absences; personal leave outside them is unpaid, deducted at the monthly wage ÷ 21.75 a day (人社部发〔2025〕2号).

name: Annual leave (带薪年休假)
authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave), a leap year read as 366 by CALENDAR_DAYS rather than the measure’s 365, and deemed service (register CN-N05, CN-N18). Recorded defaults where the law is silent (owner rule 2026-09-28; 人社厅函〔2009〕149号, http://www.mohrss.gov.cn/ldgxs/LDGXlaodongbiaozhun/LDGXLgongshixiujia/200904/t20090415_86611.html, answers only the twelve months and cumulative service): the calendar year in which twelve months are first completed is granted in full from the day they are, not pro-rated from that day (a 1 October 2025 hire with no earlier service holds 5 days for 2026 from 1 October 2026, and a 31 December 2026 exit is paid 5); a year in which cumulative service reaches 10 or 20 years is granted the higher band in full from that day (a 1 July 2016 hire holds 5 days for 2026 before 1 July 2026 and 10 from it). Neither grants less than a pro-rated reading.

name: Maternity leave (产假及生育假)
authority: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.2: a lawful birth adds 60 days of 生育假, taken with the maternity leave and paid as it; the added days extend past a statutory holiday. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The maternity allowance offset against the wage (沪医保规〔2026〕5号, register CN-SH14) is outside this row.

name: Childcare leave (育儿假)
authority: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 and 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.3: lawfully married parents each have 5 days of 育儿假 a year until their child turns three, counted by the number of children, at normal pay; each year runs from the child's birth date. 上海市卫生健康委 口径 (Dec 2021, https://www.shqp.gov.cn/wsjkw/wsjkw/upload/202112/1202_170513_376.pdf) Q3–Q4: the year is the child's anniversary year (born 1 December 2021: to 30 November 2022), used within it. Each parent holds the days separately. The lawful-birth test is the operator’s record (register CN-SH13).

name: Family-planning procedure leave (计划生育手术假)
authority: 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号), art.19, effective 1 November 2022 through 31 October 2027: paid leave from the procedure date; simultaneous procedures accumulate. IUD insertion/removal 2 days, IUD follow-up 1 day, vasectomy 7, tubal ligation 30, implant insertion 5/removal 3, diagnostic curettage after an IUD or implant 5. Abortion, post-procedure sick leave, no heavy work after insertion, and simultaneous-procedure overlap still require review (register CN-SH51). https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/rkjsqy2/20230417/e10b476cd14d4af6b079f644c0028d60.html

authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave), a leap year read as 366 by CALENDAR_DAYS rather than the measure’s 365, and deemed service (register CN-N05, CN-N18). Recorded defaults where the law is silent (owner rule 2026-09-28; 人社厅函〔2009〕149号, http://www.mohrss.gov.cn/ldgxs/LDGXlaodongbiaozhun/LDGXLgongshixiujia/200904/t20090415_86611.html, answers only the twelve months and cumulative service): the calendar year in which twelve months are first completed is granted in full from the day they are, not pro-rated from that day (a 1 October 2025 hire with no earlier service holds 5 days for 2026 from 1 October 2026, and a 31 December 2026 exit is paid 5); a year in which cumulative service reaches 10 or 20 years is granted the higher band in full from that day (a 1 July 2016 hire holds 5 days for 2026 before 1 July 2026 and 10 from it). Neither grants less than a pro-rated reading.

name: Maternity leave (产假及生育假)
authority: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.2: a lawful birth adds 60 days of 生育假, taken with the maternity leave and paid as it; the added days extend past a statutory holiday. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The maternity allowance offset against the wage (沪医保规〔2026〕5号, register CN-SH14) is outside this row.

authority: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 and 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号, from 1 November 2022 to 31 October 2027, https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/nw12344/20221110/87151565cd6246c99854c129797d178c.html) art.3: lawfully married parents each have 5 days of 育儿假 a year until their child turns three, counted by the number of children, at normal pay; each year runs from the child's birth date. 上海市卫生健康委 口径 (Dec 2021, https://www.shqp.gov.cn/wsjkw/wsjkw/upload/202112/1202_170513_376.pdf) Q3–Q4: the year is the child's anniversary year (born 1 December 2021: to 30 November 2022), used within it. name: Family-planning procedure leave (计划生育手术假)
authority: 上海市计划生育奖励与补助若干规定 (沪府规〔2022〕18号), art.19, effective 1 November 2022 through 31 October 2027: paid leave from the procedure date; simultaneous procedures accumulate. IUD insertion/removal 2 days, IUD follow-up 1 day, vasectomy 7, tubal ligation 30, implant insertion 5/removal 3, diagnostic curettage after an IUD or implant 5. Abortion, post-procedure sick leave, no heavy work after insertion, and simultaneous-procedure overlap still require review (register CN-SH51). https://www.shanghai.gov.cn/rkjsqy2/20230417/e10b476cd14d4af6b079f644c0028d60.html

Fix in place 30 Sep 2026 (a transcription omission, the law unchanged).

name: Sick leave (病假)
authority: Certified sickness or non-work injury, paid on the day wage (the monthly wage ÷ 21.75). To 15 August 2026, 沪劳保发〔95〕83号 items 3–5 (https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/tgzfl_17732/20230901/t0035_1418018.html): continuous leave within six months pays 60/70/80/90/100% by continuous service under 2/4/6/8 years and above; beyond six months 40/50/60% under 1/3 years and above. Continuous service is this stint’s completed months plus the recorded prior service months, and the six months count from the episode’s first day (recorded defaults, register CN-SH12). From 16 August 2026 HRSS confirmed the 1995 notice expired and no successor rate was found: the pay is the lawful minimum, 80% of the city minimum wage (劳部发〔1995〕309号 item 59, https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/xxgk2020/fdzdgknr/zcfg/gfxwj/zh/202103/t20210330_412011.html; owner rule 2026-09-28, register CN-SH15); a contract or collective agreement paying more is the unit’s own row. Every day is floored at 80% of the minimum wage on the day wage; the 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 floor net of the employee’s contributions is not modelled (CN-SH12.net-floor-80pct). The medical period is not limited here (CN-SH15.protected-medical-period).
